newsitem.title: JAPAN: FUJI TV SHARES ADVANCE ON DEALER PURCHASES.
newsitem.headline: FUJI TV SHARES ADVANCE ON DEALER PURCHASES.

text.p: Shares of nationwide broadcaster Fuji Television Network Inc continued to advance on Wednesday morning, on purchases by dealers who aim to take profits later, traders said.
Fuji TV's shares briefly climbed to 738,000 yen, the highest level since they were listed on the Tokyo bourse on August 8. The previous high of 730,000 yen was marked on Tuesday.
At 0042 GMT, Fuji TV's share price was up 12,000 yen at 731,000 yen. Its trading volume was 7,555 shares.
